question: the maintainer's supplement (2026-11-03): review the CANDIDATES Nemotron-SFT-Agentic-v4 (tool_calling first), Toucan-1.5M and the NeMo Gym Pivot pair (plus ToolACE and Nemotron-Agentic named earlier) -- card, real schema, revision, licence, upstream generator provenance, sample content, tool results, verifier, backend, isolation -- and compare. None is approved for training.

reuses.review_v1: logs/stages/stage-2/teacher_modes/audit/tool_calling_source_review.json (licences, gates, generator terms, coverage matrix; not repeated)

method: Hub API (commit sha, licence tag, gate, file sizes); the official cards (README.md at the pinned revision); real rows: Toucan's SFT config whole (119,287 rows), the two Pivot files (first 20,000 step rows each), ToolACE whole (11,300), and HTTP range heads of Nemotron-SFT-Agentic-v4 tool_calling (2,526 rows of 549,707) and Nemotron-Agentic-v1 interactive_agent (593 rows); isolation screened by exact prompt key (shared.eval_sets) and tool family against eval-set-1's 1,419 held-out prompt keys and 12 held-out tool families. Downloads and heads stay outside git (artifacts/.../tool_sources, manifest.json).

nvidia/Nemotron-SFT-Agentic-v4.provenance: card: synthetic single- and multi-turn trajectories 'generated with Qwen3.5-397B-A17B and GLM-5.2'; tool-set origin not stated; created 2026-10-09; replaces the tool-calling data of Nemotron-SFT-Agentic-v2
nvidia/Nemotron-SFT-Agentic-v4.observed_schema: messages (system / user / assistant with reasoning_content and tool_calls / tool with tool_call_id), tools (OpenAI envelopes), uuid, parallel_tool_calls, used_in ('Super-3.5-VL' on every sampled row)
nvidia/Nemotron-SFT-Agentic-v4.observed_sample: median 7 tools offered, 2 assistant turns, 1.38 user turns per row; 135/2,526 rows with parallel calls; system prompts empty in the head
nvidia/Nemotron-SFT-Agentic-v4.tool_results: model-generated (e.g. an 'OpenWeatherMap' reply with a prose forecast); no execution record
nvidia/Nemotron-SFT-Agentic-v4.gold_and_verifier: none: the recorded calls are the generators' own; no verifier or judge statement on the card
nvidia/Nemotron-SFT-Agentic-v4.backend: none (a replay of the recorded responses only when the teacher's call equals the recorded one)
nvidia/Nemotron-SFT-Agentic-v4.verification_class: G2-weak: agreement with the upstream generator's call; schema; behavioural (no call)
nvidia/Nemotron-SFT-Agentic-v4.recency_and_scale: the newest and largest candidate (October 2026, 549,707 rows)
blockers: OpenMDW-1.1's terms were not read in full: whether outputs and derived training data carry obligations is unconfirmed
GLM-5.2's output terms are not in the earlier generator review (Qwen3.5-397B-A17B is Apache-2.0 there)
the tool sets' origin is unstated: whether any derive from Glaive/xLAM (T3) cannot be confirmed from the card; v2 (its predecessor) did
no verifier: only schema and agreement with the generator's call; the head is not a random sample (the file's first 32 MB)

Agent-Ark/Toucan-1.5M.size: 21.81 GB in four configs (Kimi-K2, OSS, Qwen3, SFT); the SFT config, 119,287 rows (0.43 GB), downloaded and hub-sha256-verified
Agent-Ark/Toucan-1.5M.provenance: card/paper: tasks by Mistral-Small, Devstral-Small, GPT-OSS, Kimi-K2, Qwen3-32B; trajectories by GPT-OSS-120B, Kimi-K2, Qwen3-32B (all permissive, review v1); tool specs from real MCP servers; the SFT config carries no per-row metadata.synthetic_data_gen_configs (the per-model configs do)
Agent-Ark/Toucan-1.5M.observed_schema: uuid, subset_name, question, target_tools, tools (OpenAI envelopes, JSON string), messages (user / assistant / tool_call / tool_response; a tool_call's content is a Python-literal {'name', 'arguments'})
Agent-Ark/Toucan-1.5M.observed_sample: subsets: irrelevant 40,000 (no call), multi-turn 35,243 (2-4 user turns), single-turn-original 28,254, single-turn-diversify 15,790; 1-5+ calls per row; about 6-14% of rows with an error response followed by recovery; 20-40% of calling rows with a later call reusing an earlier response's content (heuristic); 41,151 repeated first prompts (T5 collapses them)
Agent-Ark/Toucan-1.5M.tool_results: REAL MCP executions recorded June-Sept 2025, including real failures (e.g. 'McpError ... Traceback' from the collection machine)
Agent-Ark/Toucan-1.5M.gold_and_verifier: no gold arguments; target_tools (the seed tools) and their order; the irrelevant subset's no-call
Agent-Ark/Toucan-1.5M.backend: replay of the recorded responses for exact-match calls; the live servers are not reproducible offline
Agent-Ark/Toucan-1.5M.verification_class: G2 (target tools / order), B (no call); execution realism from recorded responses
blockers: per-row generator not recorded in the SFT config: accept the card's all-permissive statement, or verify each row against the per-model configs (download only what is matched)
third-party MCP content and machine paths in error traces: generations over them stay outside git (P15)
replay misses whenever the teacher's call differs from the recorded one: the episode is refused (a selection effect, reported)

nvidia/Nemotron-RL-Agentic-Function-Call.size: function-calling 9,620 step rows (0.29 GB); conversational 1.75 GB (first 20,000 step rows read); both downloaded, hub-sha256-verified
nvidia/Nemotron-RL-Agentic-Function-Call.provenance: review v1: DeepSeek-V3.2, GLM-4.6, gpt-oss-120b, Kimi-K2, Qwen3 (MIT / Apache) expert trajectories; per-step rewards of a Qwen3-235B policy (conversational: qwen_235b_info, pass_rate)
nvidia/Nemotron-RL-Agentic-Function-Call.observed_schema: one row per step: responses_create_params.input (system, user, the expert's reasoning items and assistant messages, function_call / function_call_output items) and tools; expected_action (function_call with name and arguments, or message); agent_ref names the comparator
nvidia/Nemotron-RL-Agentic-Function-Call.observed_sample: function-calling: 2,824 trajectories in 6,000 steps, expected actions 52% calls / 48% messages; conversational: 4,041 trajectories, 69% calls
nvidia/Nemotron-RL-Agentic-Function-Call.tool_results: recorded function_call_output items, model-generated (e.g. a fabricated balance sheet)
nvidia/Nemotron-RL-Agentic-Function-Call.gold_and_verifier: deterministic per-step expected_action comparison (argument comparison agents): the strongest step-level gold among the candidates; per the maintainer, step matching is NOT task success
nvidia/Nemotron-RL-Agentic-Function-Call.backend: replay of the recorded outputs when the teacher's call equals the step's expected action
blockers: every step's context holds the expert's assistant turns: teacher-native use requires rebuilding each trajectory so the teacher runs from its first step (P17)
card and hub row counts disagree (review v1)

Team-ACE/ToolACE.size: 11,300 rows (37 MB), downloaded for this review
Team-ACE/ToolACE.provenance: every stage by an undisclosed 'frontier LLM' (review v1: unproven)
Team-ACE/ToolACE.observed_schema: system (the tool list as text inside an instruction) + conversations [{from, value}]; calls only as bracket strings inside assistant turns
Team-ACE/ToolACE.observed_sample: 10,500 / 11,300 rows with a single assistant turn; 1,367 tool messages in all
Team-ACE/ToolACE.gold_and_verifier: none beyond the upstream call text
Team-ACE/ToolACE.verification_class: G2-weak (agreement with the upstream call), schema after parsing the text tool list
blockers: undisclosed generator: output terms cannot be assessed
tools are text in the system prompt and need parsing into JSON Schema

nvidia/Nemotron-Agentic-v1.provenance: Qwen3-235B-A22B (Thinking/Instruct), Qwen3-32B, GPT-OSS-120B; tool_calling's tool sets from public datasets incl. glaive-function-calling-v2 (review v1)
nvidia/Nemotron-Agentic-v1.observed_schema: uuid, messages (system policy / user / assistant with tool_calls / tool), license, used_in, tools, reasoning
nvidia/Nemotron-Agentic-v1.observed_sample: interactive_agent: tau-bench-style customer service under a written policy; simulated tool outputs
nvidia/Nemotron-Agentic-v1.recency_and_scale: 2025; superseded for tool calling by the v2/v4 line

isolation_screen.rule: exact prompt key (shared.eval_sets.prompt_key of the first user message) and tool family against eval-set-1's held-out units
not_yet_run: the 13-gram (R2) and benchmark screens for the Pivot pair, v4, ToolACE and Nemotron-Agentic-v1 (they are not converted)
Glaive/xLAM-derived tool-set detection (T3) for Nemotron-SFT-Agentic-v4 beyond exact matches
isolation_screen.toucan_full_screen_2026_11_03: audit/tool_pool_dry_run_v2.json: against eval-set-1 0 prompt keys, 0 13-gram near-duplicates, 1,878 tasks refused for a held-out tool's bare name (factorial 1,856, get_news 22; none with the same name and schema); against BFCL v3, When2Call, API-Bank, tau-bench and ToolSandbox 2 exact prompts refused, 0 near-duplicates, 0 tool identities (bare-name-only hits counted, not refused). The 'tool family' column above compared whole tool-set hashes, which cannot see a shared tool inside different sets: superseded for Toucan by the atomic comparison

comparison.criteria: verifiable gold or real executions or a reproducible backend first; then recency and quality (2025-2026); licence and generator provenance; teacher-native conversion cost; category coverage

ranking.why: the only candidate with REAL tool executions (failures included) and recovery; multi-turn, parallel, no-tool and MCP coverage; permissive licence and generators
ranking.role: primary pool source: selection, no-tool, multiple/parallel, multi-turn, errors, MCP

ranking.why: the strongest deterministic step-level gold (expected_action comparator); clean licence
ranking.role: selection and schema/arguments; per-step gold only, never task success; teacher runs from step one

ranking.why: newest and largest, strong generators, multi-turn and parallel structure, but simulated tool results and no verifier; its licence terms, GLM-5.2's terms and its tool-set origin are open
ranking.role: CONDITIONAL supplement for task material where 1-2 run short, under G2-weak verification; only after the three blockers are resolved

ranking.why: policy-following multi-turn agent tasks; no verifier; simulated tools
older, mostly single-turn, undisclosed generators, simulated responses

comparison.is_a_new_source_clearly_better: No single new candidate dominates: Nemotron-SFT-Agentic-v4 is newer and larger than Toucan, but Toucan's recorded real executions and the Pivot sets' deterministic step gold are what the protocol's verification needs; v4 adds scale without a verifier. Recommendation: Toucan + Pivot as the pool's base, v4 as a conditional supplement once its licence, GLM-5.2 terms and tool-set provenance are confirmed. Nothing frozen is replaced.

coverage_by_category.schema_arguments: Pivot (G2 per step), v4 (G2-weak); Toucan schema only
coverage_by_category.no_tool: Toucan irrelevant subset (B), Pivot message steps (B)
coverage_by_category.multiple_parallel: Toucan (names/replay, no gold args), v4 parallel 5% (G2-weak)
coverage_by_category.multi_turn: Toucan (2-4 user turns, real results), Pivot conversational (G2 per step), v4
coverage_by_category.error_recovery: Toucan: recorded real tool errors, 'corrected_retry' (an error, then a successful call of the same tool with other arguments) and 'tool_failure' (errors without one), no gold; 'ask for the missing value': no source (revised 2026-11-03; v1 counted any response containing 'error', including '"error": null')

remaining_gaps: 'ask for the missing parameter' with gold
a task-success verifier: no candidate's Toucan task verifies more than tool selection (calls_tools / no call); Pivot adds per-step gold, not task success
near-duplicate and benchmark decontamination of the Pivot pair and v4 once converted (Toucan's is done: audit/tool_pool_dry_run_v2.json)
a registered tool-calling evaluation (eval-set-2) for closed-loop success

teacher_native_rule: every source contributes task material only -- user turns, tool schemas, recorded tool responses for replay, recorded calls as gold where they are gold; no upstream assistant turn, reasoning or call is ever a target; the hybrid and Thinking-2507 generate every assistant turn themselves (tool_episodes.py)

toucan_dry_pool.what: Toucan's SFT config converted (tool_sources_toucan.py) and assembled by tool_pool.assemble with eval-set-1 isolation; a DRY run into scratch, nothing written under data/, nothing generated
toucan_dry_pool._reading: 91,044 tasks after T5 collapsed 28,243 duplicates; every category in every split; the length bound (6,144) would exclude about 1% (19 of a 2,000-task sample under each of the three templates)
toucan_dry_pool.superseded_by: audit/tool_pool_dry_run_v2.json (2026-11-03, the maintainer's independent review): per-atom splits, step-based categories, real error detection, replay conflicts refused, eval-set-1 / benchmark / between-split decontamination, the length bound applied by the entry point; 82,083 tasks admitted of 119,287
v1_defects: the combined server-string family could put one MCP server in two splits
'errors_missing_parameters' was any response containing the substring 'error' (including '"error": null'); 'multiple_parallel' was two calls in total, not two in one step
a call recorded with different responses kept the first silently
the 6,144-token bound was sampled (2,000 tasks), not applied: main() passed no length checker
